about: Hot Mic lyric decoding scenarios, read by Tests/LibraryTests/LyricScenarioTests.swift. Inputs: `live` lines as [text, at, end, fixed?] (fixed = Whisper on that line; "" = Whisper gave nothing), or `words` as [word, at] (arrival-timed, 0.3 s each, cut into lines by the live rules) with `fixes` aligned to the resulting lines; `takes` as {id, at, dur, kind, text, words?, chords?}. Each option's `sheet` is what the window would show: lines, each a list of versions oldest to newest (the newest shows unless one is starred with '★ '); a version may be {text, chords}. `decided` = the option chosen (the harness asserts it); null = open, the harness reports which option today's code produces. Punctuation counts: the harness compares lowercased text WITH commas and periods. The lines are test material.

groups.name: Where a line ends
groups.blurb: The live recognizer cuts your singing into lines as you go: a pause of 0.9 s, 16 words, or 1.2 s of quiet ends a line. These ask where the cuts should fall.

groups.name: Stray words and ad-libs
groups.blurb: One-word bits, yeahs, stutters, false starts, talking, counting in.

groups.name: Same line again: repeat or version?
groups.blurb: The heart of it. When you sing a line again, is it a new line on the sheet (a chorus, a hook) or a version of the one before (you reworked it)?

groups.name: Which words show
groups.blurb: Two readings of every line: what the live recognizer heard as you sang, and what Whisper hears a second later from that line's own audio.

groups.name: Fast rap, over a beat, quiet mic
groups.blurb: Fast rap on a quiet AirPods mic broke the live recognizer into fragments and Whisper gave nothing back on most of them.

groups.name: The whole session
groups.blurb: Order, sections, recording again into the same session, imported recordings.

groups.name: The ones that depend
groups.blurb: The two readings of every line. LIVE WORDS: what Apple's recognizer hears the instant you sing, rough but immediate. WHISPER: a second listen a moment later on that line's own audio, usually better, sometimes worse. Today Whisper's words show when it gives any. Drilling a line versus meaning it five times, and other cases that depend.
